output.one_liner: Neo4j is a graph database platform with REST and GraphQL APIs for executing queries and managing cloud instances.

access.notes: AuraDB Free tier has no expiration, requires no credit card, one free instance per account

evidence.snippet: The free tier doesn't expire, requires no credit card, and needs no infrastructure to set up or maintain.
You can only create one Free instance per account.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Free tier: 25 req/min; Pro with billing: 125 req/min; Billing endpoints: 10 req/day

evidence.snippet: The Neo4j HTTP API allows to execute a series of Cypher statements against a Neo4j server through HTTP requests.
Executes a directorsAggregate GraphQL query to count directors in Neo4j.
AuraDB Free and AuraDB Professional trial accounts without a billing method attached, get a rate limit of 25 requests per minute.
Neo4j MCP implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that lets applications connect to external data sources and tools.

buildability.rationale: Composio toolkit already exists with 21 tools; free tier provides self-serve credentials; multiple auth methods supported.

overview_evidence.snippet: The Aura API allows you to programmatically perform actions on your Aura instances without the need to log in to the Console.
Neo4j Sandbox is no longer maintained. For new projects, start with AuraDB Free, our fully managed cloud graph database.

unknown_reasons.api_surface: OpenAPI spec format not explicitly confirmed; webhooks not mentioned in provided documentation.
